item.text: {"verdict":"accurate","confidence":0.99,"rationale":"参考节选逐字包含该引文，并明确将作品归于荷马，而上下文中的第一人称叙述表明说话者是奥德修斯；该段位于《奥德赛》第9卷的独眼巨人情节中。","cited_evidence":["“Cyclops, you ask my name and I will tell it you; give me, therefore, the present you promised me”","“my name is Noman; this is what my father and mother and my friends have always called me.”","“I said to him as plausibly as I could”"]}
